id: 04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario
title: 新实验，先评估
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario/src.py

points.K2: 先查现有风险评估和规程
points.K5: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，举着一块空白写字板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench holding up a blank clipboard with a magnifier icon.
shots.narration: 这一课：接到新实验，第一步做什么？

shots.scene: 老周把一张空白任务卡交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank task card to the female graduate student in his office.
shots.narration: 老周交给小研一项新的实验操作。

shots.scene: 小研戴紫色手套，托着一只培养皿，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, goggles and purple gloves holds a closed culture dish and looks thoughtful.
shots.narration: 这是课题组以前没做过的步骤。

shots.section_title: 先查现有风险评估和规程
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的风险评估表和规程文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank risk assessment form and a blank procedure binder on her desk.
shots.narration: 她先翻出现有的风险评估表和规程。
overlay: 先查现有风险评估和规程

shots.section_title: 先查现有风险评估和规程
shots.scene: 表格上几行打勾，最后一行是空白
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with several rows checked in green and the last row empty with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可是新步骤，表上并没有写到。

shots.scene: 小研眉头紧锁，身旁浮现飞溅、气溶胶、锐器三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns; small icons of a splash, a mist cloud and a needle float beside her.
shots.narration: 会不会多了溅洒、气溶胶或锐器风险？

shots.scene: 阿杰凑过来，摆手说“先做了再说”，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans over and waves his hand casually; an icon of a rushing runner beside him is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：先做了再说。这样不行。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在小研身边，竖起手掌示意停下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to the female graduate student and raises a paw in a stop gesture.
shots.narration: 拿不准的风险，要先评估再动手。

shots.scene: 小研合上文件夹，放下培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the binder and puts the closed culture dish back on the bench.
shots.narration: 第一步：先停下，不擅自开始。

shots.scene: 小研敲门走进老周办公室，指着空白任务卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student knocks on the older man's office door and points to the blank task card.
shots.narration: 把担心的风险告诉实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着一张空白的风险评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student sit together and discuss a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 第二步：一起做书面风险评估。

shots.scene: 三个图标依次出现：放大镜、天平秤、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons appear one by one: a magnifier, a balance scale, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 找出危害，估计后果，定下控制措施。

shots.scene: 控制措施金字塔：替代、工程控制、管理、个人防护
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid icon with four layers: a swap arrow, a fume hood, a checklist, and goggles with gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 先替代和工程控制，再管理和个人防护。

shots.scene: 表格最后一栏是应急图标：洗眼器、急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The bottom of a blank form shows icons of an eyewash station and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 万一出事怎么处理，也要写进去。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑上修改空白规程文档
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student edits a blank procedure document on a computer with a pencil icon on screen.
shots.narration: 第三步：根据评估，修订操作规程。

shots.scene: 老周在空白规程上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the blank procedure document with a pen.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人审核签字，才能执行。

shots.scene: 王老师在学院办公室翻看空白备案表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank registration form in the school office.
shots.narration: 涉及病原、危化品的，按规定报审备案。

shots.scene: 小研在王老师指导下练习，空白培训记录上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student practices with a closed container under the guidance of the safety administrator; a blank training record gets a check mark.
shots.narration: 第四步：培训到位，防护和应急备好。

shots.scene: 老周站在小研身旁，看她第一次正式操作
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands beside the female graduate student as she performs the new procedure for the first time at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 第一次操作，请有经验的人在旁指导。

shots.scene: 循环箭头：评估、执行、复查、改进
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon with four segments: a checklist, a hand at work, a magnifier, and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步：做完复查，发现问题就改进。

shots.scene: 试剂量放大、换了仪器、换了人三个图标，各带感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with an exclamation mark: a larger flask, a new instrument, and a new person. No people.
shots.narration: 用量、设备、人员变了，都要重新评估。

shots.scene: 日历图标上圈出一个日期，旁边是评估表
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with one date circled next to a blank assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 就算没变，也要定期复审。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现停止手掌和评估表图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a raised stop hand and a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 新操作有疑问，先停下来报告。

shots.scene: 评估表、签字笔、培训记录三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: an assessment form, a signing pen, and a training record. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、修订、审批、培训，再动手。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon around a small flask. No people.
shots.narration: 情况一变，重新评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研站在生物安全柜旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye beside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 先评估，再动手，下次见！
